meta.title: A live RFQ with a vendor's bid: "Rejected Bids": "Close" closes it and changes nothing
gaps: Exact before-and-after comparison of the event's bidding times and all vendor details after closing the window
warnings: can only test part of this — no step for: Exact before-and-after comparison of the event's bidding times and all vendor details after closing the window

steps.note: Open the prepared live RFQ with one vendor bid directly on its Responses tab.
Confirm the existing vendor bid is present before opening Rejected Bids.
Open the Rejected Bids window from the RFQ stage Settings menu.
Confirm the Rejected Bids window opened.
Close the Rejected Bids window without taking any rejection action.
Verify the Rejected Bids window is closed.
Confirm the existing bid remains visible after closing and was not changed.
